name: Lookup-table-free voxel meshing via connected wireframes
definition: A surface meshing approach that avoids Marching Cubes/Transvoxel lookup tables by constructing connected components of inside/outside vertices and edge segments, then triangulating the resulting non-planar polygons.
summary: Lookup-table-free voxel meshing via connected wireframes extracts isosurfaces by triangulating connected wireframe components, resolving topological ambiguities through global connectivity analysis rather than local cell configurations.
